response.explanation: At line 9, src/presentation/server.ts imports DropTextClient from the persistence layer. At lines 41-44 it builds the client from the DROPTEXT_URL and DROPTEXT_API_KEY environment variables. At line 45 it passes the client to IceMonitorService in the business layer. The file never calls DropTextClient methods. It uses the class only to build and wire objects at startup, which is the job of a composition root. FF-S03 still flags the edge because a presentation-layer module depends directly on a persistence-layer module and skips the business layer. The same pattern appears for every other repository and client in this file (lines 1-4, 6 and 10), so this edge is one example of a broader wiring choice rather than a stray data access. The supplied material has no documentation, ADR or comment that names server.ts as a composition root or allows this edge.
